newsitem.title: USA: N. American Scientific Vancouver delisting.
newsitem.headline: N. American Scientific Vancouver delisting.

text.p: North American Scientific Inc said the Vancouver Stock Exchange, at the company's request, agreed to delist the company's shares effective December 31.
The company said its shares would continue to trade on the OTC bulliten board.

North American Scientific said it decided to have its shares delisted from the Vancouver exchange because its primary operations were in California and a majority of its shareholders were U.S. residents.
It also said it had taken initial steps to establish a viable trading market for the shares in the United States.
The company makes and markets low level radioactive sources and standards for nuclear medicine, industrial and other commercial applications.
